title: Moving out of the apartment, six weeks to the day
variant: Grouped by time, one card per window, a sticky progress counter
prompt: A checklist for moving out of my apartment, from six weeks before to the day of.
note: Grouped by time because a renter works the list in calendar order, so each window is its own card with a brand kicker naming the week and a heading naming what the week is about, and a sticky counter with a thin progress bar sits above the cards since the list runs six weeks and the reader wants to know how far along they are at a glance. Ticks persist in localStorage for the same reason, the pill marks only the seven items that touch the deposit or a bill so it stays meaningful, and tips sit under the item as a second dimmed line rather than in a column, which keeps the page calm and single-column at every width.
